title: JWT-authorized CLI session completion request
description: CLI session authorization MUST be performed by an active tenant membership with role owner, resolved from the verified issuer and subject; caller-supplied tenant ownership is forbidden. The provider MUST revalidate the row-locked session's persisted requested scopes as a non-empty unique subset of the current allowlist before API-key creation; malformed, duplicate, empty, unsupported, or retired persisted scopes MUST fail closed.
